evidence.summary: Sensor data at cycle 124 shows coolant_flow_l_min decreased 3.1% below baseline (z=-1.9) and filter_dp_bar increased 9.4% (z=1.7), indicating reduced flow and elevated differential pressure.
RUL estimate for unit U017 is 79.7 cycles, policy band above_50_monitor, suggesting the unit is still operational but monitoring is required.
SOP-C-202 describes symptoms of coolant filter clog as high filter differential pressure and dropping coolant flow, matching observed sensor deviations.
Diagnosis notes that high filter differential pressure with normal inlet pressure indicates cartridge loading with swarf, consistent with current inlet pressure (4.998 bar) unchanged.

report.summary: Unit U017 exhibited an anomaly with coolant flow reduced by 3.1% and filter differential pressure increased by 9.4% at cycle 124. RUL remains above 50 cycles, but immediate inspection of the coolant filter is advised to prevent further performance degradation.

hits.title: Coolant filter clog: differential pressure high

hits.title: Coolant leak: detection and repair
hits.text: Low pressure and low flow at the same time indicate loss of fluid, not a blockage. A blockage shows high filter differential pressure instead (see SOP-C-202). Inspect hoses, quick-connect fittings and the pump seal.
